evidence.summary: LOCAL pooled supervised adaptation remained low; best supervised MRI-only AUROC was approximately 0.548, with negligible gain over pooled reference and a material train-test gap; full encoder fine-tuning did not materially raise the ceiling.
LOCAL0 was stable versus GAP0 across five seeds and LOCAL3 was the confirmed pooled response baseline.
The diagnostic oracle suggested spatially localized phenotype information, while fixed pooling variants did not establish a pCR gain or FTV-independent signal.
Fixed central/inner/outer shell readouts did not recover a stable pCR or beyond-FTV gain; conclusions remained mask-free-at-readout diagnostic only.
Current MRI-only pCR discrimination was weak and no timing established stable clinical or clinical+FTV incremental value.
MedicalNet and DINOv1 references were mixed and did not establish consistent beyond-FTV value or justify immediate encoder replacement.
The DINOv3 post-hoc comparison remained diagnostic rather than clean external validation and did not remove the need for a controlled supervised ceiling test.

synthesis: The next diagnostic is supervised spatial learning: compare pooled LOCAL, full-map GAP, learned LOCAL aggregation, full-context tokens, and direct raw-image supervision under the unchanged C1B-H DCE7 input contract.
